arguments.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

We have 8 of the 20 navy, size M hoodies on hand; the remaining 12 are not currently available, and none are on order. We don’t have a confirmed restock date, so we can’t confirm all 20 are ready now. The list price is $58 each ($1,160 for 20). Your bulk discount request is separate and remains under review; no discount has been approved. Would you like us to follow up about the 8 currently on hand and the remaining 12 when availability is confirmed?

Campus Customs Customer Service
